notes: Authoritative visual data for Meridian Fracture. Owner: art direction (docs/spec/art_direction.md). Presentation-only: excluded from every sim/data hash.
All colours are sRGB hex authoring values (albedo). Measured render fidelity rules are in art_direction.md section 5.2.

Colour ids and keys in player_colors match docs/spec/net.md lobby colour ids (0..11); the hex values here are authoritative (net.md values for ids 0..7 are placeholders). Faction order (bible order): napc, nec, olm, def, pd, han, ae, sap.

palette.napc.name: North American Peace Corps
palette.napc.dna: Broad, tall-ish stacked hulls; modular bolt-on armour tiles; glazed crew cabins; rescue-orange hazard trim.

palette.nec.name: New European Confederation
palette.nec.dna: Long, low, faceted wedges; angular turrets; fold-out sensor masts; crisp fine panel seams; amber sensor slits.

palette.olm.name: Order of the Levant and Mediterranean
palette.olm.dna: Light, leggy, ivory hulls; draped teal fabric screens; copper heat shields; articulated swing-arm wheels.

palette.def.name: Democratic Eurasian Federation
palette.def.dna: Boxy slab armour; exposed running gear; standard containers; big welded plates; heavy wear.

palette.pd.name: Pacific Dominion
palette.pd.dna: Smooth sealed hulls with rounded chines; flotation collars; folding flight surfaces; deck-mounted drone pads.

palette.han.name: Han Empire
palette.han.dna: Compact hulls built from identical modules; round turrets; sensor crowns; standard drone racks; porcelain caps.

palette.ae.name: African Empire
palette.ae.dna: Chunky utilitarian hulls; mismatched bolt-on repair panels; oversized reinforced wheels; swappable weapon modules with cyan lock collars.

palette.sap.name: South Asian Protectorate
palette.sap.dna: Stepped, laminated armour (sand over indigo); outrigger braces; big interception sensor panels with saffron rims.

neutral_palette.name: Neutral / civilian / resource props
neutral_palette.note: Civic grey concrete with civic-blue/white signage; no team plate, no faction accent. Salvage props are gunmetal + rust with a warm glint. Never uses faction accents or player colours.

shared_colors.note: Colours shared by all factions and props; never faction-tinted.

sub_accent_rule.text: sub_index 1: lightness moved away from mid-grey by 12 L*; sub_index 2: hue -18 deg; sub_index 3: hue +18 deg (CIE LCh, chroma preserved, gamut-clamped)

kit_parts.shelter_roll: Grey-white rolled shelter (0.22 m dia, 0.6 m) on infantry backs / vehicle decks.

unit.napc.raptor_multirole_fighter.recipe: Falcon fuselage class, canted twin tails, chined nose; 4 under-wing pylons: 2 cream-tipped AA rails + 2 orange-tipped AV pods that recolour with the loaded weapon set; USA tail checker band.

unit.napc.condor_stealth_bomber.recipe: Rotor-less faceted flying wing (sawtooth trailing edge), cream underside, one bomb-bay door line; camouflage = edge shimmer, cream fades to 35 % alpha. Silhouette change is total (gunship -> wing).

unit.napc.beaver_amphibious_apc.recipe: Boat-hull 6-wheel APC: raised prow, cream sponsons, prop-guard shrouds aft, snorkel stack, keeps the roof spinner and bubble cab.

unit.napc.narwhal_amphibious_tank.recipe: Guardian turret on a sealed hull: folding wave-breaker vane on the glacis, cream sponsons folded up on the deck, aft water-jet ducts, sealed gun boot. Same size card as the Guardian (mbt_t1).

unit.napc.vanguard_rifle_squad.recipe: Rifle squad with a folded portable cover shield on each back (olive plate, orange edge); deployed = 1.1 m cover panel stands in front (DEPLOY part).

unit.napc.aguila_breach_team.recipe: Heavy plate-carrier infantry: rectangular orange breach-charge pack, short grenade launcher, visored helmets; NO medical marking.

unit.nec.fen_recon_carrier.recipe: Sealed amphibious hull with float collar; a fold-out mast unfolds to 6 m (amber head) on deploy - exposed, so the mast is bright.

unit.nec.fjord_missile_carrier.recipe: Amphibious 6-wheel hull carrying a 4-tube canted missile pack; tube caps white, amber strip; tubes lie flat when moving, rise 35 deg to fire.

unit.nec.marte_heavy_mbt.recipe: Leopard silhouette x1.15, thicker glacis wedge with appliqué plates, larger angular turret, two mast stubs.

unit.nec.charlemagne_siege_tank.recipe: Longer rail gun on a heavier hull; deploy drops ground spades (DEPLOY) and the barrel extends telescopically +25 %.

unit.nec.alpine_pioneer.recipe: Infantry with a grey-white shelter roll and folding spade on the back; the deployed shelter is a small tent prop (0.9 m).

unit.nec.ibex_crawler_gun.recipe: Compact tracked howitzer: wide stubby crawler tracks with deep cleats, short thick barrel, front slab armour, rock-guard fenders; no wheels.

unit.olm.dawn_laser_aa.recipe: Hooded lens turret replaces the missile pods: glass-copper prism lens, teal cooling fins, gold beam emitter.

unit.olm.ifrit_prism_tank.recipe: Sunlance chassis with a faceted 6-face prism cluster in a copper cradle; deploy = outriggers + prism rises 0.6 m and opens.

unit.olm.dune_rover.recipe: Open-cage 4-wheel dune buggy: roll cage, draped camo netting, cream/teal; camouflage shimmer.

unit.olm.scorpion_rocket_buggy.recipe: Light buggy with a canted 12-tube copper rocket rack on a scorpion-tail arm over the rear.

unit.olm.gate_guard.recipe: Riot-shield infantry: teal-faced 0.5 m shield held in front; slower stride.

unit.olm.strait_frigate.recipe: Escort hull with a heavier forward gun house, shorter mast, extra deck gun, copper hull band.

unit.def.ural_assault_tank.recipe: Hammer hull +15 %, two round APS pods on the turret cheeks, slab front plates; the deck container is replaced by an APS radar box.

unit.def.bear_siege_crawler.recipe: Very low wide crawler tracks, front wall of three slabs, one fat demolition cannon, tiny slit cupola.

unit.def.steppe_recon_carrier.recipe: Lighter wheeled truck-cab with a tall extending recon mast and antenna fan; pale-yellow spare fuel drums.

unit.def.saker_missile_truck.recipe: 6x6 truck carrying two large single guided-missile canisters (Anvil has a rocket-pod block); raise 20 deg on deploy.

unit.def.fortress_guard.recipe: Infantry with a tripod heavy rifle (DEPLOY) and a slab shield; sandbag-coloured ground plate under the deployed team.

unit.def.echo_team.recipe: Two-person team: radio pack + a flat decoy-tank frame strapped to the back that unfolds as the decoy.

unit.pd.outrider_howitzer.recipe: 8x8 wheeled howitzer, barrel x1.35, wheeled stabiliser feet, coral muzzle brake, narrow-arc mount.

unit.pd.wedge_recon_fighter.recipe: Delta-wing fighter with a sensor spine and a chin sensor ball; fold-able wingtips.

unit.pd.kancil_landing_skimmer.recipe: Wake Skimmer hull widened with a bow ramp and grab rails; lighter turret.

unit.pd.island_raider.recipe: Marine squad, lighter kit, snorkel masks pushed up on helmets, coral wrist bands, bright dry bags.

unit.pd.shinano_adaptive_tank.recipe: Tide hull with a two-mode turret: low mobile gun plus a folding long-barrel siege module that unfolds upward; coral hazard at the hinge.

unit.pd.shogun_drone_carrier.recipe: Deck split in two: left half strike-drone launch rails (coral), right half interceptor cradles (white); sensor-ball tower.

unit.han.imperial_guard_tank.recipe: Ox hull +10 %, long-barrel gun with fume extractor, porcelain shoulder plates and a crimson band; shorter crown.

unit.han.long_command_walker.recipe: Wider stance with a deployable outrigger ring; larger crown that extends 2 cells (tines lengthen on deploy).

unit.han.canopy_ranger.recipe: Rifle infantry with leaf-clip ghillie tunics (jade + brown) and low packs; camouflage shimmer.

unit.han.reed_rocket_skimmer.recipe: Small amphibious hovering skimmer with a 6-tube rocket pod and a reed-green skirt; unmanned (no hatch).

unit.han.lotus_drone_tender.recipe: Jade Carrier hull with a lotus-petal drone dock ring (4 folding petals) on the roof and a small manipulator arm.

unit.han.mekong_field_engineer.recipe: Operator with a folding boom antenna and tool belt; stationary deploy unfolds a mast (command-field provider stays readable via mini crown).

unit.ae.civic_rifle_team.recipe: Riflemen with a belt of sensor pucks (cyan discs, 0.12 m).

unit.ae.lagos_drone_guard.recipe: AA vehicle with a small repair drone docked on the turret roof in a cyan-lit cradle.

unit.ae.okapi_amphibious_carrier.recipe: Amphibious wheeled carrier, tall bulky cargo hold with cleaner sheet panels (thin armour), float collar.

unit.ae.river_warden.recipe: Armed salvage infantry in reed-green cloth wrap with a cutting torch; camouflage shimmer.

unit.ae.rhino_rail_tank.recipe: Buffalo hull with a long rail barrel between two capacitor cylinders (cyan rings); little splash.

unit.ae.protea_gun_carrier.recipe: Gun on a turntable with a swappable canister shroud; module collar in cyan; switches 3 s.

unit.sap.arjun_assault_tank.recipe: Bulwark with an APS ring: four small saffron radar patches on the turret corners, thicker layered front.

unit.sap.gaj_siege_platform.recipe: Heavy platform with huge front braces (outrigger legs deploying), lowered chassis, long sleeved barrel.

unit.sap.naga_amphibious_carrier.recipe: Amphibious carrier with a six-tube smoke bank at the rear, serpentine wave-cut hull, float collar.

unit.sap.river_marine.recipe: Marines with lighter shields on the back and saffron life-vests.

unit.sap.shaheen_missile_battery.recipe: Tracked missile battery with 4 long canted tubes; stabiliser legs deploy (DEPLOY part); sensor mast.

unit.sap.watchpost_recon_team.recipe: Observers with a tripod optic and camouflage cloak; cloak shimmer.

metrics_rendered.conditions: Filmic tonemap, studio-like spike lighting (sun 1.9 warm + blue fill), team_key plate, Color->Vector4 uniform fix applied

damage_types.shape: tracer streak 1.2-2.0 m x 0.06-0.10 m; muzzle flash warm white; impact: dust puff (the look's sand colour) or metal sparks
compact orange fireball + hard spark burst; missiles trail white smoke with orange exhaust
large fireball + AoE truth ring + dust ring + dark smoke column + debris
continuous beam (0.9 m wide), white core, faction-hued body, heat shimmer, scorch mark, embers
instant helical streak, blue-white; supersonic ring + lens flare; barrel capacitor glow
orbital slug: sky streak + incandescent sheath, white flash, dust column, expanding ring
expanding cyan ring + crawling arcs + white sparks; victims flicker cyan

tiers.examples: small arms, machine gun, autocannon, beams (per tick)
tank cannon, AT/AA/air/drone missiles (splash 0, floor tier 1), naval gun, missile artillery, torpedo hit
siege gun, rocket barrage, mortar, grenade, canister
artillery shell, naval bombard, bomb, flak airburst, cruise missile
demolition cannon, depth charge, heavy bomb, structure collapse (small)
superweapon packets, structure collapse (large), aircraft crash

key.to_sun: to_sun = (cos(el)*sin(az), sin(el), cos(el)*cos(az)); +Z is south, camera yaw 0 looks toward -Z

fog_of_war.note: Values of the terrain spike shaders (terrain.gdshader, minimap_fog.gdshader); remembered structures follow render.md UF_GHOST

look.temperate_day.label: Temperate day
look.temperate_day.note: Default. Clear day, saturated greens, crisp shadows.

look.arid_day.label: Arid noon
look.arid_day.note: Bleached noon, high sun, pale sky, heat haze. Hardest for ivory/sand hulls (OLM, SAP) and ochre (AE): keep the dark mass.

look.arid_dusk.label: Arid golden hour
look.arid_dusk.note: Golden hour, long shadows to the north-east, warm skew. Stylised: hull colours shift strongly (median dE00 13.9) while plate hue drift stays within 6 degrees.

look.urban_overcast.label: Urban overcast
look.urban_overcast.note: Flat overcast light, low shadow, high ambient, strong SSAO. Neutral grey ground makes every hue pop; NEC slate blue is the weakest hull.

look.coastal_morning.label: Coastal morning
look.coastal_morning.note: Low soft sun, cool haze; water and sand; hulls skew toward teal, olive NAPC shifts most.

look.tundra_dawn.label: Tundra dawn
look.tundra_dawn.note: Snow, cold blue shadows, low warm sun. Hardest for OLM ivory; shadows are long and blue.

look.monsoon_haze.label: Monsoon haze
look.monsoon_haze.note: Humid green haze, low contrast, teal fog; olive NAPC is weakest.

look.night_ops.label: Night operations
look.night_ops.note: Optional time of day. Cool moon key, high exposure; team plates and lamps carry the read. Lighting over the map's day terrain set (temperate when selected directly).

look.studio_neutral.label: Studio neutral (QA reference)
look.studio_neutral.note: QA reference lighting: white sun, neutral ambient, no grade. Palette and plate measurements are taken under this look only.

map_look.note: MapData.biome (terrain_movement.md: 0 temperate, 1 desert, 2 arctic, 3 tropical) x MapData.family (0 open, 1 urban, 2 coast_river) -> look name; the optional night time-of-day applies the look.night_ops lighting over the terrain set of the day look; look.studio_neutral is QA only.
